verdict.rationale: The documentation only describes the relay qualitatively as providing "low-latency media streaming" via QUIC. It gives no end-to-end latency target, no measured latency figures, and no latency path characterized as suitable for live conversation. Community comments about smooth demo playback are anecdotal and do not measure latency, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation
